design.name: SAFE_LABEL_ONLY One-BM Runner
design.principle: One BM per invocation. Reads approved decisions. Dry-run default. Explicit --write.

hygiene.sourceIdGuard: exact match against approved decisions sourceId field
hygiene.arrayCountLogging: dynamic — log actual contract counts, never hardcoded literals
hygiene.countGuards: assert actual parsed counts match approved decision expected counts
hygiene.unusedImports: none — all imports must be used
hygiene.dynamicLogging: all array counts, field counts, and deltas logged from actual parsed data

guards.note: Approved decision sourceId must use full form: 'BM-XXX__<sha256>'

guards.check: contract.docxSlots.length === pre-apply count (from manifest or pre-read)
every canonicalFields[N].path === approved path for that index
every canonicalFields[N].label === approved.oldValue for that index
proposed JSON === original JSON except canonicalFields[N].label
contract.canonicalFields.length === pre-apply count AND all paths match

required: BM code as positional argument: node apply-safe-label-only.mjs BM-001

outputs.dryRun: No file writes. Console summary only.

manifestFields: changes list with index, path, before, after

deltaReporting.approach: Run post-apply audit for the specific BM only

constraints.noBulkMode: One BM per invocation. No loops.
constraints.noDryRunInWrite: If --write is set, --dry-run must not also be set
constraints.noDocxSlotsModification: Runner aborts if any approved decision includes docxSlots changes
constraints.noRenderBindingsModification: Runner aborts if any approved decision includes renderBindings changes
constraints.noPathChanges: Runner aborts if any canonicalFields[N].path differs from approved
constraints.noFieldCountChanges: Runner aborts if canonicalFields.length !== pre-apply count

errorHandling.guardFailure: Abort with exact guard name and expected vs actual values
errorHandling.parseError: Abort with file path and error message
errorHandling.preWriteGuardFailure: No file writes; clean exit with error

migration.bm002ScriptStatus: Preserve as-is (already applied). Do not modify logic. Only hygiene fixes allowed.
migration.futureBms: All future SAFE_LABEL_ONLY applies use the generic runner.
migration.approvedDecisionFormat: Must include: templateCode, sourceId (full form), patchType, expectedCounts object (canonicalFields, docxSlots, renderBindings), exact changes with canonicalFieldIndex, oldValue, newValue, expectedDeltas
